title: Brazilian Smoked Chicken Bake
description: A smoky twist on a classic chicken bake, inspired by Brazilian flavors. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together milk, butter, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Add the cubed bread to the bowl and toss until bread is evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, toss together the chopped cilantro and shredded cheese.
In a 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange half of the bread mixture in the bottom.
Place the smoked chicken breasts on top of the bread.
Sprinkle the remaining bread mixture over the chicken.
Top with the cilantro and cheese mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the top is golden brown.
Let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.
